responsibility: This file implements mc’s generic ADDRESS stack using the Indexing dynamic array as backing storage. It manages push/pop semantics, top replacement, depth accounting, and random access to stack elements, and is used by parser passes such as mcp3–mcp5 to manage expression, loop, and statement construction state during AST building.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the concrete implementation of the mcStack stem, representing stack as a record with an Indexing list and count and implementing HALT-based bounds checks; mcStack.def only exposes the abstract API.
